procedures.title: Critical-function dependency mapping procedure
procedures.purpose: Describes how the bank identifies and documents critical or important functions and their ICT-asset dependencies for the currently known subset.
procedures.trigger: Scheduled annual review, or an ad hoc change to a known critical function or its supporting ICT assets.

steps.action: Function owner confirms whether a known function remains critical or important and lists its directly supporting ICT/information assets.
steps.output_description: Updated function-to-asset listing for the known subset.
steps.exception_handling: A function outside the currently known subset is logged as an open mapping item pending confirmation against the complete underlying function inventory, not assumed absent.

steps.action: ICT risk team records dependencies between the listed assets, systems and processes, including known third-party dependencies.
steps.output_description: Updated dependency map for the known subset.
steps.exception_handling: Unmapped or unconfirmed dependencies are logged as open items.

procedures.title: ICT third-party register of information update procedure
procedures.purpose: Describes how known ICT third-party contractual arrangements are recorded and kept up to date in the register of information.
procedures.trigger: A new ICT third-party contractual arrangement is signed, amended, or terminated, or a scheduled periodic reconciliation falls due.

steps.action: Vendor/procurement contact notifies the ICT risk team of a new, amended, or terminated ICT third-party contractual arrangement.
steps.exception_handling: Arrangements outside the currently known population are logged as an open item pending reconciliation against the complete contractual and vendor population.

steps.action: ICT risk team records or updates the arrangement's entry in the register, including service description, data location, and whether it supports a critical or important function.
steps.exception_handling: Incomplete entries are flagged for follow-up rather than recorded as complete.

steps.action: ICT risk team performs a periodic reconciliation of the register against known active contracts.
steps.exception_handling: Discrepancies are logged as open items; the register is not asserted complete until the full contractual population, including relevant subcontractors, is reconciled and reviewed.

procedures.title: SME/corporate credit onboarding ESG screening procedure
procedures.purpose: Describes how sector-level ESG screening is applied to a new SME/corporate lending application.
procedures.trigger: A relationship manager submits a new SME/corporate credit application.

steps.action: Relationship manager records the applicant's economic sector/activity as part of the application file.
steps.output_description: Sector/activity classification recorded on the application.
steps.exception_handling: If sector cannot be determined, the application is held pending clarification.

steps.action: Credit analyst applies the sector-level ESG screening checklist and flags applications in higher-risk sectors.
steps.output_description: Completed screening checklist with a flag outcome.
steps.exception_handling: Flagged applications are routed to step 3; unflagged applications proceed through normal credit decisioning.

steps.action: Flagged applications are escalated to senior credit risk review before a decision is made.
steps.output_description: Senior review decision recorded on the application file.
steps.exception_handling: No defined process currently exists for periodic re-screening of the same counterparty later in the lending relationship; this is a recorded, intentional gap, not a step of this procedure.

escalation_conditions: Application flagged as higher ESG risk under the sector screening checklist.

procedures.title: Small-trading-book-business threshold monitoring procedure
procedures.purpose: Describes how the bank monitors its trading-book business volume against the CRR small-trading-book-business threshold.
procedures.trigger: Monthly scheduled review, or a material change in trading-book positions.

steps.action: Market risk team compiles the aggregated absolute value of long positions plus the absolute value of short trading-book positions for the month.
steps.exception_handling: If trading-book position data is unavailable, the result is recorded as insufficient_evidence rather than assumed to be within threshold.

steps.action: After the current legal rule, measurement scope and complete monthly inventory are reviewed, compare the documented positions with all applicable Article 94 conditions.
steps.output_description: Conditional comparison, or insufficient_evidence when the legal rule or current population is unverified.
steps.exception_handling: The current fixture lacks a verified rule and complete current scope: record insufficient_evidence and do not execute an automatic derogation decision.

steps.action: Market risk team records the monthly result and escalates if the threshold is approached or exceeded.
steps.output_description: Monthly monitoring record, escalated where applicable.
steps.exception_handling: Escalate missing scope evidence or a confirmed breach to the designated Treasury and Risk roles; their synthetic allocation still requires human approval.

escalation_conditions: Aggregated trading-book business volume approaches or exceeds the small-trading-book-business threshold.

procedures.title: Web-channel Verification of Payee procedure
procedures.purpose: Describes how the web/online-banking channel performs Verification of Payee before a credit transfer is authorised.
procedures.trigger: A payer initiates a credit transfer through web/online banking and enters or selects a payee.

steps.action: System captures the payee name and IBAN entered or selected by the payer.
steps.output_description: Captured payee name/IBAN pair ready for verification.
steps.exception_handling: If capture fails, the transfer cannot proceed to authorisation.

steps.action: System performs the Verification of Payee check comparing the entered payee name against the account holder name for the given IBAN.
steps.output_description: A match, close-match, or no-match result.
steps.exception_handling: On a no-match or close-match result, the payer is shown a warning before being able to proceed.

steps.action: System displays the verification result to the payer before offering the option to authorise the transfer.
steps.output_description: Payer decision to proceed or cancel, recorded against the transaction.
steps.exception_handling: Payer may proceed after an explicit acknowledgement of a no-match/close-match warning, or cancel the transfer.
